test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 4 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Find the compound interest on a sum of ₹1,200 at 12% per annum for 6 months, if the interest is calculated on a quarterly compounding basis.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹1,200

Annual Interest Rate (R) = 12%

Time (T) = 6 months = 0.5 years

Quarterly Compounding

**Formula Used:**

Compound Interest (CI) = P × (1 + (R)/(n times 100))ⁿT - 1

Where:

P = Principal amount

R = Annual interest rate

n = Number of times interest is compounded per year

T = Time in
